publication_rules: No factual, quotation or relationship claim is publication-ready without inspectable supporting evidence.
A source-checked belief is evidence of that telling, not proof that the narrated event happened.
Approved_for_publication requires a recorded human decision for that candidate; never derive it from a populated template.
Quotation requires exact wording, speaker, context and locator; unsupported wording stays an unpublished research lead.
Filmed_at needs production/location evidence; set_in or about does not imply filmed_at.
Historical names and boundaries require their own time scope; do not collapse them into modern geography.
Current visitor advice needs a checking date and explicit area/season applicability. Unknown values must not become promises.
Unknowns and not_applicable are distinct; not_applicable requires a reason.
Public local-participation entries use invitations and public contact details; private consent documents are not stored in the public KB.
Keep detailed credits at the page end; retain belief, period, quotation attribution and generated-depiction context beside relevant material.

compatibility.migration_state: Not migrated; coverage map references existing canonical records without copying their content.
compatibility.storage: Reviewed files in Git; no new database, backend or service.

reference_conventions.entity_id: Stable type:slug identifier; reuse existing IDs. Templates may have null IDs and are not publishable entities.
reference_conventions.local_ids: Claim, relationship, source and asset IDs must be unique within their canonical record and resolvable wherever referenced.
reference_conventions.record_pointer: Path is relative to the KB root; pointer is an RFC 6901 JSON pointer into that file, including escaped ~ and / segments when needed.
reference_conventions.date: ISO calendar date when precision is known. Historical event ranges retain precision rather than invented exact dates.
reference_conventions.unknown: Null or empty collection plus a research gap; absence is not evidence of nonexistence.
